notes: The Coast Guard removed the per-rating ASVAB table from its public manual in April 2023 (COMDTINST 1500.10D) and keeps it on a login-only site. No current official public table exists.
Effective 1 Nov 2021 (ACN 112/21), every rating's composite requirement was reduced by 10 points except Diver. Subtest minimums and AFQT alternatives did not change.
Only IT's post-2021 value (162) is confirmed in official text. Every other 'derived' value is the last known pre-2021 figure minus 10.

Pre-2021 figures marked 'official' come from Coast Guard school pages or the 2016 ASVAB Process Guide. Those marked 'wikipedia' come from an uncited Wikipedia table that matches all seven officially checkable rows exactly.
Commanding officers can waive up to 10 composite points, including subtest minimums but never the AFQT. Rating Force Master Chiefs can waive more.
AS on a score report is the combined Auto and Shop Information standard score.

ratings.name: Avionics Electrical Technician
ratings.job: Repair aircraft avionics and electrical systems; fly as navigator or sensor operator.
ratings.demand: Not on FY2024 to FY2026 bonus lists.
ratings.gate: Aircrew vision standards apply.

ratings.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician
ratings.job: Inspect, maintain and repair aircraft engines, hydraulics and airframes; fly as flight mechanic or loadmaster.
ratings.demand: Not on bonus lists. Experience counts toward the FAA A&P license.
ratings.gate: Reported waits of 14 to 17 months (anecdotal, 2024 to 2025). Aircrew vision standards.

ratings.name: Aviation Survival Technician
ratings.job: Helicopter rescue swimmer and EMT. The most physically demanding rating.
ratings.demand: Critical shortage reported by the Coast Guard (2022). About 350 serve at a time.
ratings.gate: School attrition historically over 50 percent. Only 15 to 30 graduate a year.

ratings.name: Boatswain's Mate
ratings.job: Navigate and command boats, lead crews, conduct law enforcement boardings. Most leadership opportunity of any rating.
ratings.demand: Vested Crewmember rating: a guaranteed BM school can mean an E-4 billet right out of boot camp.
ratings.gate: Found at nearly every operational unit.

ratings.name: Culinary Specialist
ratings.job: Run the galley: meals, menus, inventory and accounting for a crew.
ratings.demand: Bonus-eligible every year FY2024 to FY2026, up to $65,000 to $75,000.
ratings.gate: Critical rating; the 4-month A-school wait was waived in 2026.

ratings.name: Cyber Mission Specialist
ratings.job: Defend Coast Guard networks and the marine transportation system from cyber threats. New rating.
ratings.school: 27-week Navy Joint Cyber Analysis Course, Pensacola, FL
ratings.demand: Not on enlistment bonus lists.
ratings.gate: Top Secret/SCI clearance, U.S. citizenship without dual nationality, 9 to 18 months for the clearance. A combined AR+VE of 110 has been attributed to a Coast Guard article but could not be verified.

ratings.name: Damage Controlman
ratings.job: Welding, plumbing, carpentry and shipboard firefighting and damage control.
ratings.demand: FY2024 bonus $20,000. Vested Crewmember rating. Welding certifications reimbursed.
ratings.gate: None found.

ratings.name: Diver
ratings.job: Military diving: salvage, underwater cutting and welding, hull inspection.
ratings.school: 21 weeks, Navy Diving and Salvage Training Center, Panama City, FL
ratings.demand: Its composite was the only one not cut in 2021.
ratings.gate: Not a recruit-contract school. Requires a Physical Screening Test; opened to E-2 through E-4 in July 2026. No reliable public composite found.

ratings.name: Electrician's Mate
ratings.job: Power generation and distribution, propulsion motors and control systems on cutters and ashore.
ratings.demand: Bonus-eligible FY2025 and FY2026. Critical rating in 2026.
ratings.gate: None found.

ratings.name: Electronics Technician
ratings.job: Install and repair communications, navigation, radar and computer systems on cutters and ashore.
ratings.gate: Secret clearance eligibility and normal color vision.

ratings.name: Gunner's Mate
ratings.job: Small arms, shipboard weapons, ammunition and pyrotechnics.
ratings.demand: Not on bonus lists. Vested Crewmember rating.
ratings.gate: None found.

ratings.name: Health Services Technician
ratings.job: Emergency care, lab, pharmacy, X-ray and dental work; may prescribe within scope.
ratings.demand: Not on bonus lists. EMT crossover.
ratings.gate: AR minimum of 50.

ratings.name: Intelligence Specialist
ratings.job: Collect and analyze intelligence and brief commanders.
ratings.demand: Not on bonus lists.
ratings.gate: Handles classified material; a Top Secret clearance requirement is reported but unconfirmed.

ratings.name: Information Systems Technician
ratings.job: System administrator for classified and unclassified networks, phones and computers.
ratings.demand: Not on bonus lists.
ratings.gate: Secret clearance eligibility. The only rating whose post-2021 composite is confirmed in official text.

ratings.name: Machinery Technician
ratings.job: Diesel engines, HVAC, hydraulics and boat machinery. Often the Engineering Petty Officer at a station.
ratings.demand: Bonus-eligible every year FY2024 to FY2026. The Coast Guard is short of MKs at E-4 and E-5.
ratings.gate: Reported waits of 0 to 3 months (anecdotal, 2024 to 2025). Found at nearly every unit.

ratings.name: Marine Science Technician
ratings.job: Pollution response, vessel and facility inspections, hazardous cargo.
ratings.demand: Not on bonus lists.
ratings.gate: A-school list was closed to new students in 2022; historically very long waits.

ratings.name: Maritime Enforcement Specialist
ratings.job: Boarding teams, force protection and deployable specialized forces. The law enforcement rating.
ratings.demand: Not on bonus lists.
ratings.gate: The official ME school page still showed VE+AR 100 in 2026, so the cut may not apply or the page may be stale. Ask.

ratings.name: Operations Specialist
ratings.job: Command center watchstanding, search and rescue planning, radio communications.
ratings.demand: Bonus FY2024 ($15,000 to $40,000) and FY2025. Short at E-4 and E-5.
ratings.gate: Handles classified information.

ratings.name: Public Affairs Specialist
ratings.job: News writing, photography, video and social media; the Coast Guard's storytellers.
ratings.demand: Not on bonus lists.
ratings.gate: Small rating. The list has opened and closed repeatedly; mandatory command screening.

ratings.name: Storekeeper
ratings.job: Procurement, inventory, contracting and accounting.
ratings.demand: Not on bonus lists.
ratings.gate: VE minimum of 51.

ratings.name: Yeoman
ratings.job: Personnel records, pay and entitlements, human resources.
ratings.demand: Not on bonus lists.
ratings.gate: None found.
